scopes.Core: Initial semantic/numeric language and Polars release target; draft scope.
scopes.Integration: Gated typed-cell, segmented, resource, or demanding-client extension.

entries.name: add
entries.contract: Same dtype; checked I64 overflow; F64 follows the specified floating operation; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; no reassociation or operand reordering by default.

entries.name: sub
entries.contract: Same dtype; checked I64 overflow; F64 follows the specified floating operation; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; no reassociation or operand reordering by default.

entries.name: mul
entries.contract: Same dtype; checked I64 overflow; F64 follows the specified floating operation; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; no reassociation or operand reordering by default.

entries.name: div
entries.contract: True division; converts numeric inputs to F64; IEEE zero/non-finite behaviour; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; use checked_div to make invalid division an error.

entries.name: idiv
entries.contract: Truncates towards zero; zero denominator and MIN/-1 fail; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise, fallible.

entries.name: rem
entries.contract: Truncating remainder has dividend sign; reject zero and MIN/-1; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise, fallible; not Euclidean modulo.

entries.name: neg
entries.contract: Checked I64 rejects MIN; F64 uses its documented signed-zero behaviour; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise.

entries.name: abs
entries.contract: Checked I64 rejects MIN; F64 uses its documented signed-zero behaviour; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise.

entries.name: square
entries.contract: square preserves numeric dtype with checked integer multiplication. Null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; transcendental reproducibility is limited to the selected implementation/environment.

entries.name: sqrt
entries.contract: F64 input; ordinary IEEE-style non-finite results, not implicit checked-domain errors. Null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; transcendental reproducibility is limited to the selected implementation/environment.

entries.name: exp
entries.contract: F64 input; ordinary IEEE-style non-finite results, not implicit checked-domain errors. Null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; transcendental reproducibility is limited to the selected implementation/environment.

entries.name: log
entries.contract: F64 input; ordinary IEEE-style non-finite results, not implicit checked-domain errors. Null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; transcendental reproducibility is limited to the selected implementation/environment.

entries.name: pow
entries.contract: F64 power; no I64 overload in the initial surface; null propagates.
entries.execution: Pointwise; backend must meet the selected numerical conformance policy.

entries.name: min
entries.contract: Binary primitive; propagates null and NaN. Signed-zero ties choose -0 for min and +0 for max.
entries.execution: Not an aggregate; use minimum/maximum for reduction.

entries.name: max
entries.contract: Binary primitive; propagates null and NaN. Signed-zero ties choose -0 for min and +0 for max.
entries.execution: Not an aggregate; use minimum/maximum for reduction.

entries.name: hypot
entries.contract: Scaled finite hypotenuse; null propagates. Infinity dominates NaN; otherwise NaN propagates; zero inputs yield +0. Do not use sqrt(x*x+y*y).
entries.execution: Native or specifically equivalent lowering; special-value table must match the reference evaluator.

entries.name: checked_div
entries.contract: Reject zero denominator, non-finite operands, or non-finite result in active non-null cells.
entries.execution: Fallible pointwise operation; no speculative execution across a guard.

entries.name: eq
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: ne
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: lt
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: le
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: gt
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: ge
entries.contract: No implicit mixed numeric cast; null yields unknown. F64 ordered comparisons with NaN are false; eq false and ne true.
entries.execution: Pointwise. Object-handle equality is not elementwise equality.

entries.name: and
entries.contract: Kleene and/or; xor is unknown if either operand is unknown. No truthy numeric coercion.
entries.execution: Both arguments may evaluate; this is not guarded execution.

entries.name: or
entries.contract: Kleene and/or; xor is unknown if either operand is unknown. No truthy numeric coercion.
entries.execution: Both arguments may evaluate; this is not guarded execution.

entries.name: xor
entries.contract: Kleene and/or; xor is unknown if either operand is unknown. No truthy numeric coercion.
entries.execution: Both arguments may evaluate; this is not guarded execution.

entries.name: not
entries.contract: Negates known truth values; unknown remains unknown.
entries.execution: Pointwise.

entries.name: is_null
entries.contract: Non-null diagnostic mask. is_null tests validity; is_nan/is_finite require F64 and return false for null cells.
entries.execution: Pointwise; null and NaN remain distinct.

entries.name: is_nan
entries.contract: Non-null diagnostic mask. is_null tests validity; is_nan/is_finite require F64 and return false for null cells.
entries.execution: Pointwise; null and NaN remain distinct.

entries.name: is_finite
entries.contract: Non-null diagnostic mask. is_null tests validity; is_nan/is_finite require F64 and return false for null cells.
entries.execution: Pointwise; null and NaN remain distinct.

entries.name: cast
entries.contract: Bool-to-I64/F64 uses 0/1; I64-to-F64 may round. F64-to-I64 requires finite, integral, in-range values; no numeric-to-Bool cast.
entries.execution: Explicit pointwise conversion; returns a domain error on invalid active input.

entries.name: identity
entries.contract: Shares the input handle; no evaluation or copy.
entries.execution: Graph identity.

entries.name: shape
entries.contract: Reject a dimension that cannot fit I64 when materializing the query; [] describes a scalar.
entries.execution: Metadata where known; dynamic dimensions resolve after producer execution.

entries.name: size
entries.contract: Logical element count, not byte size or internal typed-cell coordinates; checked conversion to I64.
entries.execution: Metadata or dynamic obligation.

entries.name: iota
entries.contract: Produces 0 through n-1; n=0 is empty; reject negative/out-of-range sizes.
entries.execution: Checked allocation/streaming budget; no implicit repeated data.

entries.name: range
entries.contract: Host Rust Range/RangeInclusive determines endpoints; checked length and increment.
entries.execution: Literal/source construction; bounded allocation.

entries.name: reshape
entries.contract: Exact logical element count; no inferred -1 dimension in the initial surface. Empty shapes obey the same product rule.
entries.execution: Metadata for canonical layout; view or explicit materialization otherwise.

entries.name: reshape_cycle
entries.contract: Repeats/truncates row-major logical elements; a nonempty target from an empty source fails.
entries.execution: Expansion is costed and budgeted; target with zero elements is valid.

entries.name: ravel
entries.contract: Logical row-major order; typed cells stay atomic.
entries.execution: Index view when possible, otherwise visible copy.

entries.name: transpose
entries.contract: Rank zero and one are identities. Typed-cell internals remain closed.
entries.execution: Logical index transformation; consumers may require materialization.

entries.name: permute_axes
entries.contract: Permutation must contain every visible axis exactly once.
entries.execution: Index transformation with validated bounds.

entries.name: reverse
entries.contract: Reverse last visible axis by default; rank-zero default is identity.
entries.execution: Index mapping; explicit axis on a scalar fails.

entries.name: take
entries.contract: Non-negative takes a prefix; negative takes a suffix. Clamp at axis length; never invent fill elements.
entries.execution: Index/slice operation; last axis by default.

entries.name: drop
entries.contract: Non-negative drops a prefix; negative drops a suffix.
entries.execution: Index/slice operation; last axis by default.

entries.name: rotate
entries.contract: Output coordinate i reads input (i-offset) modulo axis length. Empty axis is unchanged.
entries.execution: Coordinate-aware wrap; no flattened cross-row leakage.

entries.name: shift
entries.contract: Same sign convention as rotate; out-of-range reads use explicit .fill(value). No fill default.
entries.execution: Coordinate-aware non-wrapping shift.

entries.name: gather
entries.shape: Selected axis replaced by index-vector length.
entries.contract: Initial indices are non-null rank-one I64; negative/out-of-bounds indices fail, including inactive accesses unless guarded.
entries.execution: Indexed read; preserve declared index order.

entries.name: compress
entries.contract: Mask is a matching rank-one Bool vector; nulls require .null_mask(Error|False|True), default Error.
entries.execution: Selection retains relative order and selection-map provenance.

entries.name: replicate
entries.contract: Matching rank-one non-null non-negative I64 counts; checked total.
entries.execution: Expansion with size budget; repeated cells retain source correspondence.

entries.name: concat
entries.contract: Same cell schema and all non-concatenated dimensions agree; default last axis.
entries.execution: Ordering barrier if backend could reorder.

entries.name: sort_up
entries.contract: Sort each last-axis lane stably; grade returns lane-local indices. Require explicit null/NaN ordering when such values occur.
entries.execution: Lane-global; no opaque backend ordering defaults.

entries.name: sort_down
entries.contract: Sort each last-axis lane stably; grade returns lane-local indices. Require explicit null/NaN ordering when such values occur.
entries.execution: Lane-global; no opaque backend ordering defaults.

entries.name: grade_up
entries.contract: Sort each last-axis lane stably; grade returns lane-local indices. Require explicit null/NaN ordering when such values occur.
entries.execution: Lane-global; no opaque backend ordering defaults.

entries.name: grade_down
entries.contract: Sort each last-axis lane stably; grade returns lane-local indices. Require explicit null/NaN ordering when such values occur.
entries.execution: Lane-global; no opaque backend ordering defaults.

entries.name: unique
entries.contract: Stable first-occurrence order. Eq policy treats all NaNs as one key and signed zeros as one key; nulls form one key.
entries.execution: Global/data-dependent; vector only initially.

entries.name: member
entries.contract: Membership uses the unique key policy, including null as a key; no nullable Boolean output.
entries.execution: Global right lookup; not ordinary eq semantics.

entries.name: select
entries.contract: No guaranteed short circuit. Unknown mask produces an invalid output cell; arrays extend only under explicit/default agreement.
entries.execution: May evaluate both branches; not a guard.

entries.name: sum
entries.shape: [] by default; selected axes can remain with .keep_dims().
entries.contract: All visible axes in row-major order; exact right reduction of add; empty uses zero; null propagates.
entries.execution: No silent backend regrouping; dtype/null/association contract must match.

entries.name: product
entries.shape: [] by default; selected axes can remain with .keep_dims().
entries.contract: All visible axes in row-major order; exact right reduction of mul; empty uses one; null propagates.
entries.execution: No silent backend regrouping; dtype/null/association contract must match.

entries.name: any
entries.shape: [] by default; selected axes can remain with .keep_dims().
entries.contract: All visible axes in row-major order; exact right reduction of or; empty uses false; null propagates.
entries.execution: No silent backend regrouping; dtype/null/association contract must match.

entries.name: all
entries.shape: [] by default; selected axes can remain with .keep_dims().
entries.contract: All visible axes in row-major order; exact right reduction of and; empty uses true; null propagates.
entries.execution: No silent backend regrouping; dtype/null/association contract must match.

entries.name: minimum
entries.contract: Whole-cell aggregate of min/max; empty requires explicit .identity(value); null/NaN propagate.
entries.execution: Distinct from binary min/max.

entries.name: maximum
entries.contract: Whole-cell aggregate of min/max; empty requires explicit .identity(value); null/NaN propagate.
entries.execution: Distinct from binary min/max.

entries.name: mean
entries.contract: Whole-cell aggregate; empty/all-skipped-null input fails. Cast numeric values to F64, exact right sum, then divide by valid count.
entries.execution: Explicit reducer state/finalize contract; count must fit exactly supported range.

entries.name: variance
entries.contract: Two-pass definition using mean and right-summed squared deviations; ddof=0; require count>ddof; null propagates.
entries.execution: Alternative stable/parallel algorithms need an explicit numerical policy, not a silent rewrite.

entries.name: stddev
entries.contract: Two-pass definition using mean and right-summed squared deviations; ddof=0; require count>ddof; null propagates.
entries.execution: Alternative stable/parallel algorithms need an explicit numerical policy, not a silent rewrite.

entries.name: matmul
entries.contract: Both ranks at least two; batch frames equal or one empty; explicit broadcasting otherwise. Exact inner add/mul contraction by default.
entries.execution: Blocked execution allowed only if accumulation semantics stay equivalent.

entries.name: components
entries.contract: Explicitly opens a homogeneous numeric cell schema; preserves parent validity and declared matrix coordinate order. Heterogeneous records need another adapter.
entries.execution: Checked view or explicit repack; never assumes Rust layout.

entries.name: from_components
entries.shape: Trailing component axes become one typed element.
entries.contract: Validate shape/dtype/domain. All-valid components construct a cell; all-null give a null cell; partial component validity fails initially.
entries.execution: Checked reconstruction; domain invalidity differs from null.

entries.name: zip_aligned
entries.contract: Requires checked common logical correspondence and order, not merely equal length.
entries.execution: No join; mismatched histories require deliberate alignment/selection.

entries.name: zip_positional
entries.contract: Caller deliberately chooses positional pairing; does not assert common origin.
entries.execution: Records explicit positional boundary.

entries.name: compact
entries.contract: Preserves relative order and returns restoration indices; inactive is not an error or null.
entries.execution: Native masked/segmented boundary, with output cardinality checked.

entries.name: restore
entries.contract: Checks source domain, map uniqueness, and bounds; unselected cells retain template values.
entries.execution: Indexed write to fresh output; no duplicate-writer ambiguity.

entries.name: scatter_reduce
entries.contract: Validate bounds and collision policy; reducer declares merge/order/finalize contract.
entries.execution: Explicit indexed accumulation; deterministic mode fixes accepted ordering.

entries.name: reduce_by
entries.shape: One result per declared key group.
entries.contract: Stable key order by first occurrence unless explicitly ordered; preserves reducer policy.
entries.execution: Grouping is explicit, not hidden array alignment.

entries.name: compose
entries.contract: compose(f,g)(x) = f(g(x)); shares graph nodes.
entries.execution: Composition does not execute kernels.

entries.name: flow
entries.contract: flow(f,g)(x) = g(f(x)); matches pipeline reading direction.
entries.execution: Composition preserves fallibility/effect order.

entries.name: fork
entries.shape: Agreement of branch outputs into binary g.
entries.contract: fork(f,g,h)(x) = g(f(x),h(x)); one shared input node, distinct branch effects remain distinct.
entries.execution: No textual duplication or speculative guarded-branch lifting.

entries.name: hook
entries.shape: Input and g output must satisfy f.
entries.contract: hook(f,g)(x) = f(x,g(x)); f binary, g unary.
entries.execution: Structured graph sharing.

entries.name: over
entries.contract: over(f,g)(x,y) = f(g(x),g(y)); f binary, g unary.
entries.execution: Two applications of g, not one fused effect by assumption.

entries.name: inner
entries.contract: Pairs k in index order, then right-reduces; empty contraction needs a registered/supplied identity.
entries.execution: Not batched matmul; no ordinary Polars cross-join lowering.

entries.name: each
entries.contract: Numeric spelling of rank(0,f); typed logical elements remain closed.
entries.execution: Lifts a declared operation, not arbitrary tracing.

entries.name: rank
entries.contract: Trailing cell rank must be within input rank; empty frame uses inference, never samples a cell.
entries.execution: Dense result requires uniform output cell schema.

entries.name: rank2
entries.contract: Frames equal or one empty; no broader frame broadcast by default.
entries.execution: Checks binary cell/output schema before lowering.

entries.name: rows
entries.contract: Requires rank at least one; trailing rank-one cells, including empty ones.
entries.execution: Explicit documented convenience, not implicit row-name semantics.

entries.name: cols
entries.shape: Per-column scalar result [...,n], or vector result [...,q,n].
entries.contract: Requires rank>=2. Applies f to column vectors of each trailing matrix; permits scalar or rank-one output, otherwise use rank/permutation.
entries.execution: Column gather/view and assembly are visible to planner.

entries.name: reduce
entries.contract: Exact right association without reordering; singleton passes through; empty only uses identity; rank-zero explicit reduction fails.
entries.execution: May partition independent lanes, not the contracted lane without permission.

entries.name: fold_left
entries.contract: Nonempty unseeded left fold; singleton passes through; empty uses registered/explicit empty identity only.
entries.execution: Sequential lane state; no implicit injected initial value.

entries.name: scan
entries.contract: Each prefix receives exact right reduction; inclusive; empty output empty; generic opaque case may require quadratic work.
entries.execution: Never substitute scan_left solely because a backend has cumsum.

entries.name: scan_left
entries.contract: Inclusive left accumulation; no injected identity; empty output empty.
entries.execution: Prefix state across chunk boundaries.

entries.name: outer
entries.contract: Cartesian application to logical elements; exact size check before expansion.
entries.execution: Blocked/streamed execution possible, output still intrinsically sized.

entries.name: outer_cells
entries.contract: All pairs of cells; uniform result schema required.
entries.execution: Batch-pair tiling with cost checks, not implicit singleton insertion.

entries.name: broadcast
entries.contract: Dimensions agree when equal or one is 1; 0 with 1 gives 0; other 0 mismatch fails.
entries.execution: Explicit index mapping; does not alter domain correspondence claims.

entries.name: stencil
entries.contract: Ordered active offsets; explicit boundary policy; snapshot reads; rank-one neighbourhood passed to f.
entries.execution: Halo-dependent; rectangular axes, not flattened shifts.

entries.name: repeat
entries.contract: n=0 identity; fixed n, checked plan expansion/work budget.
entries.execution: Not adaptive convergence control.

entries.name: flip
entries.contract: flip(f)(x,y) = f(y,x).
entries.execution: Changes operand order deliberately.

entries.name: dup
entries.shape: f receives the same value twice.
entries.contract: dup(f)(x) = f(x,x); shared input.
entries.execution: Does not duplicate source evaluation.

entries.name: map_cells
entries.contract: Typed logical-element application; schema known without first-cell execution. A proof-capable map lifts the bound callable relation over corresponding cells, including failure behaviour.
entries.execution: One batch dispatch around a compiled loop, not required per-cell dynamic dispatch.

entries.name: flat_map_cells
entries.contract: Variable cardinality per input; offsets/lengths checked; no implicit dense array.
entries.execution: Expansion budget and correspondence metadata.

entries.name: per_segment
entries.shape: One independently described result per segment.
entries.contract: Preserve segment ownership/order unless f explicitly changes it; empty segment schema is inferable.
entries.execution: Segment-dependent, not arbitrary chunk-independent.

entries.name: masked_apply
entries.shape: Declared active outputs plus inactive policy.
entries.contract: No domain-sensitive kernel evaluation on inactive cells; unknown-mask policy explicit. Require the kernel precondition only on active valid cells; opaque captures and termination assumptions remain explicit.
entries.execution: Requires true guard or compact/evaluate/restore, not select lowering.

entries.name: .lhs(value) / .rhs(value)
entries.contract: lhs(a): f(a,x); rhs(b): f(x,b). Handles bind once; no host re-evaluation.
entries.execution: Inspectable partial application, not opaque currying.

entries.name: .axis(axis) / .axes(axes)
entries.contract: Zero-based axes; checked unique indices/names; no implicit negative indices. Multi-axis order is caller-specified.
entries.execution: Do not silently sort contraction axes.

entries.name: .all_axes()
entries.shape: Scalar, or singleton axes with keep_dims.
entries.contract: Canonical row-major flattening of all visible axes; rank-zero input is its sole element.
entries.execution: Typed-cell coordinates are not visible axes.

entries.name: .keep_dims()
entries.contract: Affects result shape only, not accumulation order or validity.
entries.execution: Schema-level operation.

entries.name: .identity(value)
entries.contract: Used for an empty lane only; not an initial seed and not proof of an algebraic identity.
entries.execution: Never inject into nonempty/singleton reduction.

entries.name: .skip_nulls()
entries.contract: Remove invalid elements preserving order; then apply the normal empty-input policy.
entries.execution: Requires matching validity-aware kernel; not global null coercion.

entries.name: .null_mask(policy)
entries.contract: Error default; False drops unknown selections; True selects them deliberately.
entries.execution: Does not alter NaN handling.

entries.name: .ddof(n)
entries.contract: Non-negative integer; require non-null count > n. Default 0.
entries.execution: Part of numerical definition and plan identity.

entries.name: .reassociate()
entries.contract: Permits alternative grouping only; no operand permutation, skipped failure, or implicit widening. Checked-overflow semantics still hold.
entries.execution: Planner must prove eligibility or reject the requested route.

entries.name: .fill(value)
entries.contract: Required shift fill; dtype/schema must match or require explicit cast.
entries.execution: Does not define stencil boundary handling.

entries.name: .boundary(policy)
entries.contract: Fill(value), Wrap, Reflect. Reflect excludes the edge on reflection; n=1 maps to 0; empty axes produce no neighbourhoods.
entries.execution: Kernel must fetch halos across physical partitions.

entries.name: .anchor(coords)
entries.contract: Default centre only for odd extents; even footprints require explicit in-bounds anchor.
entries.execution: Offset order follows row-major footprint traversal.

entries.name: .nulls_first() / .nulls_last()
entries.contract: Required when nullable ordering inputs contain nulls; stable within equal keys.
entries.execution: Part of ordering contract.

entries.name: .nan_first() / .nan_last()
entries.contract: Required when F64 ordering inputs contain NaNs; signed zeros compare equal with stable order.
entries.execution: Does not redefine eq or numeric min/max.

entries.name: .named(label)
entries.contract: Adds user diagnostic context, never changes semantics.
entries.execution: Label size checked; redact data values by default.

entries.name: comb!
entries.contract: Existing left-to-right pipeline; graph arithmetic/comparisons; &/|/! are elementwise; reject array &&/||. Expansion calls specified builders and preserves static descriptors when available; dynamic graphs remain supported.
entries.execution: Thin parser and hygienic construction; embedded host expressions evaluate once.

entries.name: arr!
entries.contract: Retains arr![1 2 3; 4 5 6]; require rectangularity. Parentheses delimit complex/negative cell expressions.
entries.execution: Compile-time syntax/rectangularity diagnostics; fallible checked value construction.

entries.name: array!
entries.contract: Conventional array![[1,2],[3,4]]; nested rectangular literals. Empty typed literal needs explicit dtype.
entries.execution: Same runtime value contract as arr!, not a second execution model.

entries.name: verb!
entries.contract: Local lets share nodes; graph calls lower through application protocol; host escape separates Rust evaluation. A descriptor denotes a public logical operation; no automatic compile-time evaluation of host variables.
entries.execution: Reusable inspectable graph, not callback-per-row.

entries.name: footprint!
entries.contract: Active offsets ordered row-major; odd default anchor, even explicit anchor; reject all-zero footprint initially.
entries.execution: Compile-time literal checks plus stencil configuration validation.

entries.name: flow!
entries.contract: Left-to-right composition; every descriptor expression evaluates once.
entries.execution: Optional convenience over flow; no alternative pipeline DSL.

entries.name: host { ... }
entries.contract: Special syntax inside comb!/verb!, not a Rust macro. Executes once at plan construction.
entries.execution: No tracing, I/O sandbox, or per-execution resampling.

entries.name: .apply(...) / .then(...)
entries.contract: Stable ordinary Rust API; .then takes a unary descriptor. Invalid schemas surface at preparation.
entries.execution: Does not execute kernels.

entries.name: .as_fn()
entries.contract: Clones descriptor into an ordinary closure for tap::Pipe or host combinators.
entries.execution: Does not implement custom Fn traits on the descriptor.

entries.name: .prepare(&engine)
entries.contract: Reject known impossibilities; retain symbolic obligations and resource requirements. Preparation preserves public graph meaning; certificates bind schema/policy/target/backend capabilities and revalidate residual obligations.
entries.execution: Planning only; no domain kernel invocation to infer a first cell.

entries.name: .collect() / .execute(...)
entries.contract: collect uses the default engine; execute uses prepared policies/bindings; both return domain errors.
entries.execution: Explicit execution and allocation boundary.

entries.name: .explain()
entries.contract: Shows valid prefix and all independently diagnosable failures, including copies/guards/order/unknown sizes. Report exact/bounded/estimated/unknown costs, selected engine, spill permissions, evidence scope, and remaining assumptions.
entries.execution: No forced execution; raw backend plan is opt-in.

entries.name: native(kernel, schema)
entries.contract: Trust native code; validate returned schema and boundaries; conservative effects by default. The proof-capable route retains callable/specification binding, explicit captures and higher-order pre/post/effect contracts; metadata alone is not evidence.
entries.execution: Batch-level dispatch; pure pointwise optimization needs a stronger explicit contract.

entries.name: register_lowering
entries.contract: Explicit registration by stable local identity/version; no orphan-rule dependence on foreign trait/type pairs. Backend capability and semantic-refinement evidence records are independent of the registration priority.
entries.execution: Ambiguous/unmet contracts fail clearly; no silent weaker fallback.

entries.name: parameter / bind
entries.contract: Prepared-plan reuse rechecks schema, policy, resource generation, and dynamic obligations. Source-scoped witnesses and cost certificates do not survive incompatible rebinding.
entries.execution: Plan caching never treats new data as a cached result.

entries.name: execute_into
entries.contract: Caller-owned output/scratch is available on the sequential Core route; Integration adds domain sinks. Success commits once; failure/cancellation before commit leaves the destination unchanged. Partial sinks require a distinct protocol and frame contract.
entries.execution: Initially tile-local commit; native kernels must cooperate with cancellation.

entries.name: DenseView::from_slice
entries.contract: Validates checked cardinality, logical index mapping and non-null storage; safe callers need no ghost precondition.
entries.execution: Borrowed production view with public observers and logical specification.

entries.name: NullableView::try_new
entries.contract: Validates validity length/parent mapping and preserves cell bits without treating null as a scalar value.
entries.execution: No copying required by the interface; explicit layout conversion may still be needed.

entries.name: SegmentedView::try_new
entries.contract: Offsets start at zero, are monotonic and end at value length; empty segments and ownership remain visible.
entries.execution: Public logical segments, validated borrowed representation.

entries.name: logical_view / public lemmas
entries.contract: Array/Batch models expose logical values, validity and origin; graph/build/prepare/execute contracts compose. Simple open definitions and focused closed lemmas preserve abstraction.
entries.execution: Ghost/specification surface, not an extra runtime allocation or replacement executor.

entries.name: Selection::from_mask / apply
entries.contract: Witness applies only to matching source/domain generation and policy; a matching length alone is insufficient.
entries.execution: Reusable validation with checked application; ordinary gathers may repeat indices.

entries.name: Permutation::try_new
entries.contract: Validates a complete bijection and binds it to its applicability conditions; restoration separately requires uniqueness.
entries.execution: Public composition/inversion/correspondence lemmas.

entries.name: NativeExecutor::sequential
entries.contract: Select the production sequential route, declared numeric policies, resources and output/scratch. Proof configuration never silently swaps a Polars or SIMD implementation.
entries.execution: No mandatory Polars or verifier installation for an ordinary consumer.

entries.name: StaticPlan / static_descriptor
entries.signature: fixed or symbolic descriptor + input contract
entries.contract: Retains static graph meaning under the existing comb! frontend. Arbitrary runtime graph values and host reads cannot be discovered by a proc macro.
entries.execution: Optional checked const path; ordinary dynamic descriptors continue to prepare at runtime.

entries.name: CostReport / cost_analysis
entries.contract: Distinguishes exact, conservative bounds, estimates and unknowns; costs name units, target and resource scope. Unknown is not zero.
entries.execution: Shared restricted analyser for const, preparation and runtime refinement; elapsed time remains an estimate.

entries.name: AdmissionPolicy / check_cost
entries.contract: Strict certification requires discharged upper-bound obligations; adaptive mode records runtime checks. Upper-bound excess means uncertifiable domain, not certain overrun.
entries.execution: Compile-fail where statically requested; checked runtime admission otherwise.

entries.name: ScheduleCertificate / validate_schedule
entries.signature: plan + proposed schedule + contracts -> checked admission
entries.contract: Binds executable/specification/profile identities and scoped tracked-resource bounds; arbitrary opaque declarations remain assumptions, not proofs.
entries.execution: Small checker validates planner output; stale or unsupported certificate fails closed.

entries.name: ProofEvidence / assumption_report
entries.contract: Records actual tool/version, bounds, executable/specification binding, trust, success witnesses and negative controls. No undifferentiated verified Boolean.
entries.execution: Optional proof SDK surface; a planned record is not passing evidence.

entries.name: typed_kernel_contract
entries.contract: Retains executable binding and captured inputs; callable postconditions constrain all permitted results. Reducers relate state to processed-input history.
entries.execution: Verification metadata does not alter runtime semantics or remove checks for unverified callers.

entries.name: bounded_symbolic_input
entries.signature: Kani support with explicit shape/value bounds
entries.contract: Constructs valid and invalid boundary cases deliberately; never assumes desired outputs or hides empty-only generators.
entries.execution: Optional Kani helper functions and harness contracts, not a production source.

entries.name: BackendCapabilities / require_engine
entries.contract: Python release numbering does not establish Rust capability. Record tested engine/order/numerics/extension/provenance support and explicit unavailable status.
entries.execution: Invalidates plan/certificate compatibility on relevant backend or profile change.

entries.name: SpillPolicy / execution_io
entries.contract: Temporary disk is forbidden unless explicitly authorized. Strict isolation fails if the backend exposes only incompatible global controls. Cleanup/failure status is explicit.
entries.execution: Operation-specific streaming/OOC eligibility; materialized output payload remains accounted.
